extension_description.message: A lightweight SEO audit tool that analyzes key SEO, content, and technical factors on your webpage, helping you identify issues that may affect search visibility, accessibility, or performance.

error_highlight_failed.message: Could not highlight element because it is not visible in the viewport

text_img_missing_alt.message: Highlight images with missing alt text

warning_no_data_to_display.message: No data available to display at the moment.

info_mixed_image_formats.message: Mixed modern '%s' and legacy '%s' image formats detected. Consider using modern formats where appropriate for performance, while retaining suitable fallback formats when browser compatibility requires them.

info_refresh_tab_headers.message: Reload the page to retrieve the HTTP response headers for this tab.

info_modern_image_formats.message: Modern image formats '%s' are detected. These formats can reduce image file size and improve loading performance when properly compressed and sized.

info_legacy_image_formats.message: Legacy image formats '%s' detected. Consider modern formats such as WebP or AVIF where they provide a meaningful size or performance benefit.

error_content_security_policy.message: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) is missing. This is a security finding, not a direct Google ranking requirement. A suitable CSP can reduce the impact of cross-site scripting (XSS) and other content-injection attacks.

info_content_security_policy.message: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) helps control which resources a browser may load and can reduce the impact of cross-site scripting (XSS) and other content-injection attacks.

error_x_frame_options.message: X-Frame-Options is missing. This is a security finding, not a direct Google ranking requirement. The header can help mitigate clickjacking by controlling whether the page may be embedded in a frame or iframe.

info_x_frame_options.message: X-Frame-Options controls whether a browser may render the page in a frame or iframe, helping protect against clickjacking.

info_x_xss_protection_deprecated.message: X-XSS-Protection header detected. This header is obsolete. Modern browsers ignore it or have removed support in favor of Content-Security-Policy, so its presence or absence is informational only, not a security requirement.

error_x_content_type_options.message: X-Content-Type-Options is missing. This is a security finding, not a direct Google ranking requirement. The 'nosniff' value helps prevent MIME-type sniffing.

info_x_content_type_options.message: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing a response and requires the declared Content-Type to be respected.

error_referrer_policy.message: Referrer-Policy is missing. This is a privacy and security recommendation, not a direct Google ranking requirement. A policy controls how much referrer information is sent with requests.

info_referrer_policy.message: Referrer-Policy controls how much referrer information a browser sends with requests and navigations.

error_strict_transport_security.message: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) is missing. This is a security recommendation for HTTPS sites, not a direct Google ranking requirement. HSTS tells browsers to use HTTPS for future requests after the policy has been received.

info_strict_transport_security.message: HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) tells browsers to use HTTPS for future requests to the host after the policy has been received.

info_x_ua_compatible.message: X-UA-Compatible header detected. This header is obsolete and has no effect in modern browsers. Remove it unless legacy Internet Explorer support is explicitly required.

info_alt_svc.message: Alt-Svc HTTP response header detected. It advertises an alternative service, which can include HTTP/3. This is informational and is not an SEO requirement.

info_x_robots_tag.message: X-Robots-Tag detected in the HTTP response headers.

warning_no_structured_data.message: No structured data (JSON-LD) was found on this page. Structured data can help search engines understand eligible content and may make the page eligible for supported rich results. It is not required for basic indexing or ranking.

warning_no_meta_tags.message: No meta tags were found on this page. This is not automatically an SEO error. Review whether the page has the metadata it actually needs, such as a title, robots directives, or a relevant meta description.

info_duplicate_meta_tag.message: The '%s' meta tag appears %s times on this page. Multiple instances can create conflicting or ambiguous signals. Where a tag is intended to have one value, keep a single, page-specific declaration.

info_keyword_missing_in_title_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the SEO title. This audit uses keyword presence as a relevance heuristic, not a Google requirement. Include the term only if it accurately describes the page.

info_keyword_missing_in_title_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the SEO title. This audit uses keyword presence as a relevance heuristic, not a Google requirement. Include the term only if it accurately describes the page.

info_keyword_not_in_title_first_half_pri.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' appears in the SEO title, but not within its first half. This audit flags early placement as a readability and relevance heuristic; Google does not require keywords to appear in a specific position.

info_keyword_not_in_title_first_half_sec.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' appears in the SEO title, but not within its first half. This audit flags early placement as a readability and relevance heuristic; Google does not require keywords to appear in a specific position.

info_keyword_missing_in_description_prim.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the meta description. This audit treats keyword presence as a snippet-relevance heuristic. Google may use the meta description when it provides a useful summary, but it can also generate the snippet from page content.

info_keyword_missing_in_description_seco.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the meta description. This audit treats keyword presence as a snippet-relevance heuristic. Google may use the meta description when it provides a useful summary, but it can also generate the snippet from page content.

info_keyword_missing_in_url_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the URL. A descriptive URL can help users and search engines understand the page, but including an exact focus keyword is not required.

info_keyword_missing_in_url_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the URL. A descriptive URL can help users and search engines understand the page, but including an exact focus keyword is not required.

info_keyword_not_in_content_start_primar.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear within the first 10%% of the main content. This audit uses an early mention as a topical-context heuristic; Google does not require a keyword to appear within a specific percentage of the content.

info_keyword_not_in_content_start_second.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear within the first 10%% of the main content. This audit uses an early mention as a topical-context heuristic; Google does not require a keyword to appear within a specific percentage of the content.

info_keyword_missing_in_headings_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in an H2 or H3 heading. This audit uses relevant subheadings as a content-structure heuristic; do not add keywords to headings unless they fit naturally.

info_keyword_missing_in_headings_seconda.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in an H2 or H3 heading. This audit uses relevant subheadings as a content-structure heuristic; do not add keywords to headings unless they fit naturally.

info_keyword_density_low_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' has a measured density of %s%%. This tool uses density as an internal heuristic only; Google does not publish a recommended keyword-density range. Use natural wording and cover the topic comprehensively.

info_keyword_density_low_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' has a measured density of %s%%. This tool uses density as an internal heuristic only; Google does not publish a recommended keyword-density range. Use natural wording and cover the topic comprehensively.

warning_keyword_density_high_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' has a measured density of %s%%. The repetition level exceeds this tool's warning threshold and may indicate keyword stuffing. Reduce repetition and use natural, varied language.

warning_keyword_density_high_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' has a measured density of %s%%. The repetition level exceeds this tool's warning threshold and may indicate keyword stuffing. Reduce repetition and use natural, varied language.

info_keyword_density_elevated_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' has a measured density of %s%%, above this tool's internal heuristic range. Google does not publish a recommended density range, so prioritize natural language and useful coverage over a target percentage.

info_keyword_density_elevated_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' has a measured density of %s%%, above this tool's internal heuristic range. Google does not publish a recommended density range, so prioritize natural language and useful coverage over a target percentage.

error_empty_page_title.message: Page title is missing. A clear, descriptive title helps Google understand the page and helps users identify the result in search.

info_short_page_title.message: Page title is %s characters, below this tool's heuristic minimum of %s. Google does not set a minimum title length. Review the title for clarity, uniqueness, and useful descriptive wording rather than length alone.

info_long_page_title.message: Page title is %s characters, above this tool's heuristic maximum of %s. Google does not set a maximum title length, but search-result title links may be truncated. Review the title for clarity, uniqueness, and unnecessary repetition.

warning_title_pixel_width.message: Page title renders at approximately %spx wide, above this tool's display-width heuristic of %spx. Google does not publish a fixed pixel limit, and title links are truncated as needed. Use this value as a preview aid, not a Google limit.

error_empty_meta_description.message: Meta description is missing. Google can generate a snippet from page content, but a unique, relevant description can help when Google chooses to use it.

info_short_meta_description.message: Meta description is %s characters, below this tool's heuristic minimum of %s. Google does not set a minimum length. Focus on an accurate, useful summary rather than meeting a character target.

info_long_meta_description.message: Meta description is %s characters, above this tool's heuristic maximum of %s. Google does not set a maximum length, but search snippets are truncated as needed. Focus on a concise, page-specific description.

warning_description_pixel_width.message: Meta description renders at approximately %spx wide, above this tool's display-width heuristic of %spx. Google does not publish a fixed pixel limit, and snippets are truncated as needed. Use this value as a preview aid, not a Google limit.

error_empty_page_language.message: Page language is not specified. Declaring the document language improves accessibility and helps user agents interpret the content correctly.

error_heading_nesting.message: Found %d heading hierarchy issue(s): %s is followed by H%d. Consistent heading structure improves document organization and accessibility; this is not a direct Google ranking requirement.

error_heading_h1_order.message: Found %d heading(s) %s before an H1. An H1 is not required for Google Search, but a clear main heading can improve document structure and accessibility.

error_heading_h1_missing.message: Found %d heading(s) %s, but no H1 is present. An H1 is not required for Google Search, but a clear main heading can improve document structure and accessibility.

error_heading_empty.message: Found %d empty heading(s). Empty headings provide no useful structure and can create accessibility problems. Remove them or give them meaningful text.

warning_missing_canonical_tag.message: No canonical tag was found. A canonical link is not required for indexing, but it can help Google identify the preferred URL among duplicate or very similar pages.

warning_multiple_canonical_tags.message: Found %s canonical tags on this page. When multiple canonical declarations conflict, Google may select a different canonical. Use one consistent canonical declaration where a canonical is needed.

warning_malformed_canonical_tag.message: The canonical tag '%s' could not be resolved to a valid URL. Check that its href is complete and well-formed so search engines can evaluate the canonical signal.

warning_empty_canonical_tag.message: A canonical tag is present but its href attribute is empty. It cannot provide a usable canonical signal and may be ignored.

info_canonical_has_fragment.message: Canonical URL '%s' includes a URL fragment (#...). Google generally does not support URL fragments in canonical URLs, so remove the fragment and use the canonical URL without it.

info_canonical_cross_host.message: Canonical URL '%s' points to a different host than the current page. Cross-domain canonicals can be valid, but confirm that the target is the intended representative URL.

info_canonical_points_elsewhere.message: Canonical URL points to '%s', a different URL than the current page. This can be intentional for duplicate or very similar URLs, but verify that the target is the preferred representative URL.

error_robots_txt_missing.message: No robots.txt file was found. This does not prevent indexing by itself. Add robots.txt when you need crawl directives or want to declare a sitemap location.

error_blocked_robotstxt.message: The page %s has a robots directive containing noindex, which tells compliant search engine crawlers not to index the page. Check that this is intentional.

info_long_url.message: This URL is %s characters long, above this tool's heuristic maximum of %s. Google does not publish a maximum URL length for Search. Use concise, descriptive URLs that are easy for users to understand and share.

help_checkbox_fetch_robotstxt.message: Disabling the fetching of robots.txt will prevent notifications about found sitemaps and skip checking whether internal links are blocked by robots.txt rules.

txt_headings_desc.message: Use clear, descriptive headings to organize the content and support accessibility. Headings can help search engines understand page structure, but heading levels and H1 usage are not direct Google ranking requirements.

txt_images_desc.message: Use descriptive, context-appropriate alt text for informative images. Alt text supports accessibility and helps Google understand images. Optimize image dimensions, formats, compression, and loading to improve page performance.

txt_links_desc.message: Use clear internal links and relevant anchor text to help users and search engines understand site structure. External links do not automatically increase site authority. Broken or misleading links can harm usability, while manipulative link practices can create SEO and spam-policy risks.

txt_structured_data_desc.message: Structured data helps search engines understand eligible content and can make pages eligible for supported rich results. It is not required for basic indexing or ranking, and invalid or unsupported markup does not create a rich-result opportunity.

txt_meta_desc.message: Meta elements have different purposes. The title helps describe the page in search, meta descriptions can influence the snippet when Google uses them, and robots directives can control indexing. They should be unique, accurate, and appropriate to the page.

txt_update_error.message: Unable to load page tab information. Please refresh the tab. If the issue persists, click the 'Report Error' button below.
